newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S MERSON RECALLED TO ENGLAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S MERSON RECALLED TO ENGLAND SQUAD.

text.p: Arsenal midfielder Paul Merson was recalled to the England squad by coach Glenn Hoddle on Thursday two years after his self-confessed drinks, drugs and gambling problems.

Merson, who underwent rehabiliation for his problems and has recently been playing some of the best football of his career, was among the 23-man squad named for the World Cup qualifier against Poland on October 9.
While Merson, who won the last of his 14 caps against Greece in 1994, returns, there is no place for his Arsenal teammate Tony Adams, who captained England during Euro 96.

Adams, who recently admitted he is an alcoholic, made his first start for Arsenal for eight months on Wednesday but his still struggling with a knee injury. That, rather than his drink problem is the reason he has been left out.
Young Liverpool defender Dominic Matteo, who has made an excellent start to the season, is named in the senior squad for the first time after winning three Under-21 caps.
Goalkeepers: David Seaman (Arsenal), Ian Walker (Tottenham), David James (Liverpool)
Defenders: Gareth Southgate (Aston Villa), Stuart Pearce (Nottingham Forest), Gary Neville (Man U), Gary Pallister (Man U), Sol Campbell (Tottenham), Dominic Matteo (Liverpool)

Midfield: Paul Ince (Inter Milan, Italy), Paul Gascoigne (Rangers, Scotland), David Beckham (Man U), Steve McManaman (Liverpool), David Batty (Newcastle), Andy Hinchcliffe (Everton), David Platt (Arsenal), Paul Merson (Arsenal)
Forwards: Nick Barmby (Middlesbrough), Alan Shearer (Newcastle), Les Ferdinand (Newcastle), Matt Le Tissier (Southampton), Teddy Sheringham (Tottenham), Robbie Fowler (Liverpool).
